title: Simple Lobster Scampi
description: This lobster scampi is a simple and elegant blend of pre-cooked lobster, white wine, lemon juice, and Parmesan cheese. Great served with pasta.
ingredients: 1.5 tablespoons minced garlic, or to taste
1.5 pounds cooked lobster meat, cut into bite-size pieces
0.5 cup white wine, or to taste
0.25 cup grated Parmesan cheese, or to taste
0.5 cup bread crumbs, or more as needed

steps.text: Melt butter in a skillet over medium heat. Add garlic; cook and stir until fragrant, about 2 to 3 minutes.

Add lobster and cook until heated through, about 5 minutes. Add wine and lemon juice; bring to a boil. Add Parmesan cheese; cook until melted, about 2 minutes. Add bread crumbs slowly, 2 tablespoons at a time, bringing to a boil after each addition.
